reply.executive_summary: The search aimed for cobalt-free cathodes with higher energy density than LiFePO4. The champion is Li8TiMn11(NiO8)4 with energy density 701.0 Wh/kg at voltage 4.754 V and capacity 147.4 mAh/g, volume change 3.44%, and energy above hull 0.003 eV/atom with error 0.007 eV/atom. Its voltage 4.754 V and energy density 701.0 Wh/kg are comparable to its parent Li2Mn3NiO8 at 4.718 V and 692.0 Wh/kg within the model's voltage error of 0.35 V. The other finalists are Li8Mn11V(NiO8)4 with 690.0 Wh/kg at 4.693 V and 147.1 mAh/g, volume change 3.37%, and 0.008 eV/atom with error 0.007 eV/atom, and Li8ZrMn11(NiO8)4 with 676.0 Wh/kg at 4.72 V and 143.1 mAh/g, volume change 3.89%, and 0.016 eV/atom with error 0.01 eV/atom. The champion belongs to a close family already studied. Two candidates were rejected as known: Li4MnFe3(PO4)4 already in Materials Project as mp-783919, mp-807965, mp-764613, mp-766043, mp-766130, and Li4Fe3Ni(PO4)4 already as mp-771063. DFT calculations, voltage profile beyond average voltage, oxygen redox, lithium diffusion and electronic conductivity, cycling and capacity fade, synthesis, cost of the elements, and experimental data were not computed.
